A '''man''' belonging to the personal staff of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Consul-General]] [[Dandamont Pring]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] defected from the Empire to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The defector made [[Gender/Legends|his]] move during one of Pring's famous soirees, meeting with a group of undercover [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[operative]]s. However, the defector refused to cooperate and handing over crucial [[datafile/Legends|datafiles]] unless the Rebel agents also spirited away his true love&mdash;[[Praleena Pring]], the consul-general's daughter. Ultimately, the defector and Praleena escaped from the Imperial forces on Bothawui following mass confusion among the party guests.
==Biography==
A '''man''' who was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] minor bureaucrat belonging to the personal staff of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Consul-General]] [[Dandamont Pring]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had a secret affair with [[Praleena Pring]], the consul-general's daughter, and was sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

He decided to defect from the Empire and after he made contact with Rebel [[operative]]s, offering information to demonstrate his worth to the Rebellion. As he felt that [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[agent/Legends|agents]] were watching him, he decided to make [[Gender/Legends|his]] move during one of Pring's famous soirees in [[Consul-General Pring's diplomatic estate|his estate]].

A group of undercover [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[operative]]s arrived on that evening, and identified him with a code phrase. He told his concerns, and that the [[datafile/Legends|datafiles]] he promised were in his work station, in an area that was off-limits during the party. Once he led them there, he showed on the monitor the information he promised—[[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]] movements and supply centers in a contested [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. However, the defector refused to let the Rebels download the data, or extract him, unless they also spirited away his true love. 

Having no option, the team was split up, and operatives tried to reach the Pring daughter; however right then the Consul-General aanounced her engagement with [[Unidentified Imperial captain (Dismay)|the Captain]] of the ''[[Dismay]]'' and that she would leave the next day for the wedding. Eventually, Praleena, who was not looking forward to that wedding, agreed to follow them. 

However, when the contact attempted to download the data for the Rebels, they were locked; his fears were confirmed: [[Unidentified Imperial Security Bureau agent|An ISB agent]] and several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] showed up to arrest the Rebels and the defector. This ensued into a mass confusion among the party guests that ruined the party, allowing the defector and Praleena to escape from the Imperial forces on Bothawui.

Dandamont covered up his embarrassment by dismissing the incident as young love, claiming that his daughter would return once she thought things through.
